run_gtest_help_test_with_flag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and return exit code and output
test_gtest_help_flag_full: test that gtest_help_test_ prints the help message when the --help flag is passed
test_gtest_help_flag_short: test that gtest_help_test_ prints the help message when the -h short flag is passed
test_gtest_help_flag_question: test that gtest_help_test_ prints the help message when the -? or /? flag is passed
test_gtest_runs_without_help_flag: test that gtest_help_test_ runs tests normally and does not print help when no help flag is given
